chapter: Ellington, singers, the book and closing
title: Wanting to be Leonard Bernstein
summary: He would rather be in the Boston Pops bass section writing, discovering Negro talent like Bernstein.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Critics, polls and the jazz press

blocks.x: What would you have accomplished more than you've already accomplished?
Well, the Boston Pops Symphony would be playing my music, with no name I'd be in the bass section, I'd be writing my music, and getting my kicks. It would just have been a different thing.
But would it have been the same kind of music?
Would it have the character of the --
I would do what Leonard Bernstein did. I would go out and discover Negroes. Oh, here's a new one.
This Ornette Coleman is really something. I would rather be a Leonard Bernstein.
He's above jazz, because he discovers Negroes.
